title: Health in depth
goal: Describe symptoms precisely and say how long you've had them, mention allergies and conditions, book an appointment and tests, and understand and follow a doctor's instructions.
intro:
Unit 9 got you as far as 'I have a fever'. This unit gets you through a real visit to a Bengaluru clinic: explaining exactly what's wrong and since when, answering the doctor's questions about allergies, BP and sugar, getting a blood test done, and understanding instructions like 'twice a day after food for five days'.

The key grammar is how Kannada says 'I **have had** it **for** three days': no special tense, just the present with **-ಇಂದ** 'from': ಮೂರು ದಿನದಿಂದ ಜ್ವರ ಇದೆ. The second point is the language of instructions: how often, when and how long.

vocab.note: Lit. 'head-spinning'. ತಲೆ ಸುತ್ತುತ್ತಿದೆ 'I feel dizzy', ತಲೆಸುತ್ತು ಬಂತು 'I felt dizzy'.
ವಾಂತಿ ಆಗು / ವಾಂತಿ ಬರು 'to vomit, feel like vomiting'.
Many people say ಲೂಸ್ ಮೋಶನ್ (from Indian English 'loose motions').
ಉಸಿರಾಡು 'to breathe'; ಉಸಿರು ಕಟ್ಟುತ್ತೆ 'I get breathless'.
ಕಾಲು ಉಳುಕಿತು 'I sprained my foot' (spoken ಉಳುಕ್ತು). The body part is the subject.
ನನಗೆ X ಅಲರ್ಜಿ ಇದೆ / X ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಅಲರ್ಜಿ 'I'm allergic to X'.
Dust allergy is very common in Bengaluru.
Everyone says ಬಿಪಿ. 'High BP' = ಬಿಪಿ ಜಾಸ್ತಿ; 'I have BP' = ನನಗೆ ಬಿಪಿ ಇದೆ (means high BP).
ನನಗೆ ಶುಗರ್ ಇದೆ 'I'm diabetic'. Formal: ಸಕ್ಕರೆ ಕಾಯಿಲೆ, ಮಧುಮೇಹ.
ಟೆಸ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡಿಸು 'to get a test done'.
ಮಾತ್ರೆ ತಪ್ಪಿಸಬೇಡಿ 'don't skip a tablet'; ತಪ್ಪಿಸದೆ 'without missing'.
ಪಥ್ಯ ಮಾಡು 'to keep to a diet': usually no spicy, oily or sour food.

phrases.en: I've had a fever for three days.
Since when has this been happening?
I feel dizzy. (lit. the head is spinning)
I don't have BP, diabetes or anything.
phrases.note: The doctor's routine question is ಬಿಪಿ, ಶುಗರ್ ಏನಾದ್ರೂ ಇದೆಯಾ?

phrases.en: Can I get an appointment with the doctor?
When will the report be ready?
Don't take it on an empty stomach.

phrases.note: ಪರವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ 'not bad, OK' is the usual answer when you're recovering.

grammar.title: 'I've had it for three days': -ಇಂದ with the present
grammar.body:
English uses a special tense for something that started in the past and is still going on: 'I **have had** a fever **for** three days', 'I**'ve been** coughing **since** Monday'. Kannada is simpler: it uses the **ordinary present** (ಇದೆ, or the continuous -ತಿದೆ) plus the time word with **-ಇಂದ** 'from'.

ಮೂರು ದಿನದಿಂದ ಜ್ವರ ಇದೆ 'I've had a fever for three days' (lit. 'from three days, there is fever')
ಸೋಮವಾರದಿಂದ ಕೆಮ್ಮು ಬರ್ತಿದೆ 'I've been coughing since Monday'
ಒಂದು ವಾರದಿಂದ ಈ ಮಾತ್ರೆ ತಗೋತಿದ್ದೀನಿ 'I've been taking this tablet for a week'

**One ending for 'for' and 'since'.** With a length of time (ಮೂರು ದಿನ, ಒಂದು ವಾರ, ಎರಡು ತಿಂಗಳು) it means 'for'; with a point in time (ನಿನ್ನೆ, ಸೋಮವಾರ, ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ) it means 'since'. Forms: ದಿನ → ದಿನದಿಂದ, ವಾರ → ವಾರದಿಂದ, ತಿಂಗಳು → ತಿಂಗಳಿಂದ, ನಿನ್ನೆ → ನಿನ್ನೆಯಿಂದ, ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ → ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆಯಿಂದ, ರಾತ್ರಿ → ರಾತ್ರಿಯಿಂದ, ಅವತ್ತು 'that day' → ಅವತ್ತಿಂದ. 'For ages' is ತುಂಬಾ ದಿನದಿಂದ.

**Asking**: ಎಷ್ಟು ದಿನದಿಂದ? 'for how many days?', ಯಾವಾಗಿಂದ? 'since when?' (careful form ಯಾವಾಗಿನಿಂದ).

**Ago** is different: time + -ದ + **ಹಿಂದೆ** 'behind', with a **past** verb, because it points to one moment: ಎರಡು ದಿನದ ಹಿಂದೆ ಬಿದ್ದೆ 'I fell two days ago'. A doctor will often want both: ಎರಡು ದಿನದ ಹಿಂದೆ ಶುರುವಾಯ್ತು, ಅವತ್ತಿಂದ ನೋಯ್ತಿದೆ 'it started two days ago and it's been hurting since'.

**The traps:** with -ಇಂದ, a past verb means the thing has **stopped**: ಮೂರು ದಿನದಿಂದ ಜ್ವರ ಇತ್ತು 'I'd had a fever for three days (it's gone now)'. If it's still going on, keep the present. And for instructions about the future ('take it for five days') use the bare time with **no** -ಇಂದ: ಐದು ದಿನ ತಗೊಳ್ಳಿ.

examples.en: My lower back has been hurting for ages.
I've been on BP tablets for two months.
Since when have you had this itch?

grammar.title: Instructions: how often, when, how long
grammar.body:
A doctor's or pharmacist's instructions use the **polite command** (unit 11): stem + **-ಇ** / **-ಇರಿ**: ತಗೊಳ್ಳಿ 'take', ಕುಡೀರಿ (ಕುಡಿ + ಇರಿ) 'drink', ಹಚ್ಚಿ 'apply', ನುಂಗಿ 'swallow', ಮಲಗಿ 'lie down', ಬನ್ನಿ 'come'. 'Don't' is infinitive + **-ಬೇಡಿ**: ತಿನ್ನಬೇಡಿ, ತಪ್ಪಿಸಬೇಡಿ. The stronger 'must not' is -ಬಾರದು (unit 9): ಮದ್ಯ ಕುಡೀಬಾರದು 'no alcohol'.

**How often**
ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಒಂದು ಸಲ / ಎರಡು ಸಲ / ಮೂರು ಸಲ 'once / twice / three times a day'
ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಒಂದು, ರಾತ್ರಿ ಒಂದು 'one in the morning, one at night'
ಮೂರು ಹೊತ್ತು 'with all three meals' (ಹೊತ್ತು = a mealtime)
ಎಂಟು ಗಂಟೆಗೊಮ್ಮೆ 'every eight hours' (-ಗೆ + ಒಮ್ಮೆ 'once')
ಬೇಕಾದಾಗ 'when needed'

**When**
ಊಟಕ್ಕೆ ಮುಂಚೆ 'before food'; ಊಟ ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ / ಊಟದ ನಂತರ 'after food'
ಖಾಲಿ ಹೊಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ 'on an empty stomach'
ಮಲಗೋಕೆ ಮುಂಚೆ 'before bed'

**How long**: the bare time with no ending: ಐದು ದಿನ ತಗೊಳ್ಳಿ 'take it for five days', ಒಂದು ವಾರ ಪಥ್ಯ ಮಾಡಿ 'keep to a diet for a week'. (Compare -ಇಂದ, which looks back from now: ಐದು ದಿನದಿಂದ ತಗೋತಿದ್ದೀನಿ.)

**Linking steps** with the -ಇ form: ಕ್ರೀಮ್ ಹಚ್ಚಿ ಮಲಗಿ 'put the cream on and lie down'. **Conditions** with -ಅರೆ (unit 19): ಜ್ವರ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಆಗದಿದ್ರೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಬನ್ನಿ 'if the fever doesn't come down, come back'; ನೋವಿದ್ರೆ ಮಾತ್ರ 'only if there's pain'.

**Passing instructions on**: quote them with ಅಂತ (unit 20), with an informal command inside the quote: ಡಾಕ್ಟರ್ ಊಟ ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ ತಗೋ ಅಂತ ಹೇಳಿದ್ರು 'the doctor said to take it after food'.

examples.native: ಈ ಮಾತ್ರೆ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಒಂದು, ರಾತ್ರಿ ಒಂದು ತಗೊಳ್ಳಿ
examples.roman: ī mātre beḷigge ondu, rātri ondu tagoḷḷi
examples.en: Take one of these in the morning and one at night.
Take this tablet only if there's pain.
Drink two litres of water every day.
You mustn't drink alcohol while you're on the medicine.
Apply the cream and leave it for ten minutes.

dialogue.title: At the clinic in Malleshwaram
dialogue.setting: Tom has been ill since the weekend. He sees Dr Shetty at a neighbourhood clinic in Malleshwaram.

lines.speaker: Dr Shetty
lines.en: Come in, have a seat. What's the problem?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.native: ಡಾಕ್ಟರೇ, ಮೂರು ದಿನದಿಂದ ಜ್ವರ ಇದೆ, ಮೈಕೈ ನೋವು ಕೂಡ.
lines.roman: ḍākṭarē, mūru dinadinda jvara ide, maikai nōvu kūḍa.
lines.en: Doctor, I've had a fever for three days, and body aches too.

lines.speaker: Dr Shetty
lines.en: How high is the fever? Did you check?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.native: ನಿನ್ನೆ ರಾತ್ರಿ ನೂರೆರಡು ಇತ್ತು. ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆಯಿಂದ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ವಾಂತಿ ಕೂಡ ಆಗ್ತಿದೆ.
lines.roman: ninne rātri nūreraḍu ittu. beḷiggeyinda svalpa vānti kūḍa āgtide.
lines.en: It was 102 last night. And I've been throwing up a bit since this morning.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.native: ಶನಿವಾರ ಫ್ರೆಂಡ್ಸ್ ಜೊತೆ ಪಾನಿಪುರಿ ತಿಂದೆ... ಅವತ್ತಿಂದಲೇ ಶುರು ಆಯ್ತು ಅನ್ಸುತ್ತೆ.
lines.roman: shanivāra phreṇḍs jote pānipuri tinde... avattindalē shuru āytu ansutte.
lines.en: I had pani puri with friends on Saturday... I think it started that very day.

lines.speaker: Dr Shetty
lines.native: ಹಾಗೇ ಅನ್ಸುತ್ತೆ. ಏನಾದ್ರೂ ಅಲರ್ಜಿ ಇದೆಯಾ? ಬಿಪಿ, ಶುಗರ್?
lines.roman: hāgē ansutte. ēnādrū alarji ideyā? bipi, shugar?
lines.en: Looks like it. Any allergies? BP, diabetes?

lines.speaker: Dr Shetty
lines.native: ಇಲ್ಲ, ಹೊಟ್ಟೆ ಇನ್ಫೆಕ್ಷನ್ ಅಷ್ಟೇ. ಈ ಮಾತ್ರೆ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಎರಡು ಸಲ, ಊಟ ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ, ಐದು ದಿನ ತಗೊಳ್ಳಿ.
lines.roman: illa, hoṭṭe inphekṣan aṣṭē. ī mātre dinakke eraḍu sala, ūṭa ādmēle, aidu dina tagoḷḷi.
lines.en: No, just a stomach infection. Take this tablet twice a day, after food, for five days.

lines.speaker: Dr Shetty
lines.native: ಜ್ವರ ಬಂದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಈ ಪ್ಯಾರಾಸಿಟಮಾಲ್. ಎರಡು ದಿನ ಮೊಸರನ್ನ, ಗಂಜಿ ಮಾತ್ರ. ಹೊರಗಡೆ ಏನೂ ತಿನ್ನಬೇಡಿ!
lines.roman: jvara bandāga mātra ī pyārāsiṭamāl. eraḍu dina mosaranna, gañji mātra. horagaḍe ēnū tinnabēḍi!
lines.en: And this paracetamol only when the fever comes. Only curd rice and kanji for two days. Don't eat anything outside!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.en: OK, doctor. And if the fever doesn't come down?

lines.speaker: Dr Shetty
lines.native: ಮೂರು ದಿನ ಆದ್ರೂ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಆಗದಿದ್ರೆ ರಕ್ತ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಮಾಡಿಸಿ, ರಿಪೋರ್ಟ್ ತಗೊಂಡು ಬನ್ನಿ. ಡೆಂಗ್ಯೂ ಸೀಸನ್ ಅಲ್ವಾ.
lines.roman: mūru dina ādrū kaḍime āgadidre rakta parīkṣe māḍisi, ripōrṭ tagoṇḍu banni. ḍeṅgyū sīsan alvā.
lines.en: If it hasn't come down in three days, get a blood test and bring me the report. It's dengue season, after all.

culture:
Most people in Bengaluru first go to a neighbourhood clinic or the family doctor, often without an appointment: you take a token and wait. Doctors are addressed as ಡಾಕ್ಟರೇ or ಡಾಕ್ಟ್ರೇ, or ಸಾರ್ / ಮೇಡಂ. Temperatures are given in Fahrenheit (ನೂರು 'a hundred' is a fever, ನೂರೆರಡು is a high one), and English medical words are completely normal: ಬಿಪಿ, ಶುಗರ್, ಇನ್ಫೆಕ್ಷನ್, ಸ್ಕ್ಯಾನ್, ಟೆಸ್ಟ್.

Everyone has advice when you're ill. Expect to be told to drink ಬಿಸಿ ನೀರು 'hot water', to take ಕಷಾಯ (a home-made herbal decoction with pepper, ginger and tulsi), and to eat only ಮೊಸರನ್ನ (curd rice) or ಗಂಜಿ (rice gruel) until you're better; spicy and sour foods are avoided as part of ಪಥ್ಯ. During the monsoon, a fever with body aches immediately raises the question of dengue, and doctors will send you for a blood test after a few days.

When a friend is ill, call or visit: ಈಗ ಹೇಗಿದ್ದೀಯ? ಡಾಕ್ಟರ ಹತ್ರ ಹೋಗಿದ್ಯಾ? and the cheerful ಬೇಗ ಹುಷಾರಾಗು! 'get well soon'.

tip.title: For / since: -ಇಂದ + present
tip.body:
- Still going on? Time + **-ಇಂದ** + a **present** verb: ಮೂರು ದಿನ**ದಿಂದ** ಜ್ವರ **ಇದೆ** 'I've had a fever for three days'.
- The same -ಇಂದ means 'since': ನಿನ್ನೆ**ಯಿಂದ** 'since yesterday'.
- Ask **ಎಷ್ಟು ದಿನದಿಂದ?** or **ಯಾವಾಗಿಂದ?**
- Trap: a past verb (ಇತ್ತು) would mean it's over.

sentences.en: I've been vomiting for two days.
I've had diarrhoea since yesterday.
How long have you had the cough?
I've been feeling dizzy since this morning.
Since last night I've been finding it hard to breathe.
I haven't had any appetite for a week.

sentences.native: ಜ್ವರ ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಬೇರೆ ಏನಾದ್ರೂ ಲಕ್ಷಣ ಇದೆಯಾ?
sentences.roman: jvara biṭṭu bēre ēnādrū lakṣaṇa ideyā?
sentences.en: Any other symptoms apart from the fever?
I've been feeling very tired since last month.
The vomiting has stopped, but I feel dizzy.

tip.title: Ago ಹಿಂದೆ vs for ಇಂದ
tip.body:
- **Ago** = time + -ದ + **ಹಿಂದೆ** with a **past** verb: ಎರಡು ದಿನದ **ಹಿಂದೆ** ಬಿದ್ದೆ 'I fell two days ago'.
- **For / since** = time + **-ಇಂದ** with a **present** verb: ಎರಡು ದಿನದಿಂದ ನೋಯ್ತಿದೆ 'it's been hurting for two days'.
- A story to a doctor often needs both.

sentences.native: ಎರಡು ದಿನದ ಹಿಂದೆ ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ಆಡ್ತಿದ್ದಾಗ ಕಾಲು ಉಳುಕಿತು.
sentences.roman: eraḍu dinada hinde krikeṭ āḍtiddāga kālu uḷukitu.
sentences.en: Two days ago I sprained my foot playing cricket.
There's been swelling in my knee since that day.
I've had lower back pain for a week.
I've cricked my neck, I can't turn it.
My hand has been itching for four days.

sentences.native: ಎರಡು ವಾರದ ಹಿಂದೆ ಶುರು ಆಯ್ತು, ಇನ್ನೂ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಆಗಿಲ್ಲ.
sentences.roman: eraḍu vārada hinde shuru āytu, innū kaḍime āgilla.
sentences.en: It started two weeks ago and it still hasn't got better.
I get heartburn after eating.
How many days ago did you fall?

sentences.native: ರಾತ್ರಿ ಇಡೀ ನಿದ್ದೆ ಬರಲಿಲ್ಲ, ಸೊಂಟ ತುಂಬಾ ನೋಯ್ತಿತ್ತು.
sentences.roman: rātri iḍī nidde baralilla, soṇṭa tumbā nōytittu.
sentences.en: I couldn't sleep all night, my back was hurting so much.

tip.title: Saying what you have: ನನಗೆ … ಇದೆ
tip.body:
- Conditions are 'there' for you: **ನನಗೆ** ಅಲರ್ಜಿ **ಇದೆ**, ಅಪ್ಪನಿಗೆ ಶುಗರ್ ಇದೆ.
- Allergic to X: ನನಗೆ X ಅಲರ್ಜಿ ಇದೆ, or X **ಅಂದ್ರೆ** ಅಲರ್ಜಿ 'X means allergy for me'.
- 'Not … or anything': … **ಏನೂ ಇಲ್ಲ**: ಬಿಪಿ ಶುಗರ್ ಏನೂ ಇಲ್ಲ.

sentences.en: I'm allergic to milk.
Are you allergic to any medicine?

sentences.native: ಅಪ್ಪನಿಗೆ ಬಿಪಿ ಮತ್ತು ಶುಗರ್ ಎರಡೂ ಇದೆ.
sentences.roman: appanige bipi mattu shugar eraḍū ide.
sentences.en: Dad has both BP and diabetes.
If you're diabetic, eat less sweet stuff.
There's an infection in your throat.
I'm allergic to dust.
It's nothing serious, don't be scared.

sentences.native: ನಿಮಗೆ ಬೇರೆ ಏನಾದ್ರೂ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆ ಇದೆಯಾ?
sentences.roman: nimage bēre ēnādrū ārōgya samasye ideyā?
sentences.en: Do you have any other health problems?
If there's an infection, you get a fever.
Is there a good clinic nearby?
I have an appointment at six this evening.
What time is the doctor available?
The blood test has to be done on an empty stomach.

sentences.native: ರಕ್ತ ಟೆಸ್ಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ಶುಗರ್ ಟೆಸ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡಿಸಿ.
sentences.roman: rakta ṭesṭ mattu shugar ṭesṭ māḍisi.
sentences.en: Get a blood test and a sugar test done.
You'll get the report tomorrow evening.
There's nothing wrong in the report.
Come back after a week.
The clinic is closed on Sundays.

tip.title: How often, when, how long
tip.body:
- Polite commands: **ತಗೊಳ್ಳಿ**, ಕುಡೀರಿ, ನುಂಗಿ; don't: **-ಬೇಡಿ**.
- How often: ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ **ಎರಡು ಸಲ**, ಎಂಟು ಗಂಟೆ**ಗೊಮ್ಮೆ** 'every eight hours'.
- When: ಊಟಕ್ಕೆ **ಮುಂಚೆ**, ಊಟ **ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ**, ಮಲಗೋಕೆ ಮುಂಚೆ.
- How long: the bare time, **no -ಇಂದ**: ಐದು **ದಿನ** ತಗೊಳ್ಳಿ.
tip.pattern: ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಎರಡು ಸಲ + ಊಟ ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ + ತಗೊಳ್ಳಿ

sentences.en: Take this tablet every eight hours.
Have the syrup before meals.

sentences.native: ಮಾತ್ರೆ ಊಟ ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ, ಬಿಸಿ ನೀರಲ್ಲಿ ನುಂಗಿ.
sentences.roman: mātre ūṭa ādmēle, bisi nīralli nuṅgi.
sentences.en: Swallow the tablet after food, with warm water.
Take it for five days without missing a dose.
What should I do if I miss a tablet?

sentences.native: ಒಂದು ವಾರ ಖಾರ, ಸಿಹಿ ತಿನ್ನಬೇಡಿ, ಪಥ್ಯ ಮಾಡಿ.
sentences.roman: ondu vāra khāra, sihi tinnabēḍi, pathya māḍi.
sentences.en: No spicy or sweet food for a week, keep to a light diet.

sentences.native: ಮಲಗೋಕೆ ಮುಂಚೆ ಒಂದು ಚಮಚ ಸಿರಪ್ ಕುಡೀರಿ.
sentences.roman: malagōke muñche ondu chamacha sirap kuḍīri.
sentences.en: Have a spoonful of syrup before bed.

sentences.native: ಡಾಕ್ಟರ್ ಊಟ ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ ತಗೋ ಅಂತ ಹೇಳಿದ್ರು.
sentences.roman: ḍākṭar ūṭa ādmēle tagō anta hēḷidru.
sentences.en: The doctor said to take it after food.

sentences.native: ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರೆ ನುಂಗೋಕೆ ಆಗಲ್ಲ, ಸಿರಪ್ ಕೊಡಿ.
sentences.roman: maguvige mātre nuṅgōke āgalla, sirap koḍi.
sentences.en: The child can't swallow tablets, please give us a syrup.

sentences.native: ಜ್ವರ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಆಗದಿದ್ರೆ ಎರಡು ದಿನ ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಬನ್ನಿ.
sentences.roman: jvara kaḍime āgadidre eraḍu dina biṭṭu banni.
sentences.en: If the fever doesn't come down, come back in two days.

sentences.native: ಈ ಕ್ರೀಮ್ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಎರಡು ಸಲ ಹಚ್ಚಿ.
sentences.roman: ī krīm dinakke eraḍu sala hachchi.
sentences.en: Apply this cream twice a day.

sentences.native: ಕ್ರೀಮ್ ಹಚ್ಚಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ತುರಿಕೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಆಯ್ತು.
sentences.roman: krīm hachchida mēle turike kaḍime āytu.
sentences.en: The itching eased after I put the cream on.
I'm scared of injections.
I'll give you an injection, it won't hurt.

sentences.native: ಈಗ ಹೇಗಿದೆ? ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಪರವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ, ಜ್ವರ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಆಗಿದೆ.
sentences.roman: īga hēgide? svalpa paravāgilla, jvara kaḍime āgide.
sentences.en: How is it now? A bit better, the fever has come down.

sentences.native: ಮಂಡಿಗೆ ಈ ಕ್ರೀಮ್ ಹಚ್ಚಿ, ಮಲಗಿ ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿ ತಗೊಳ್ಳಿ.
sentences.roman: maṇḍige ī krīm hachchi, malagi vishrānti tagoḷḷi.
sentences.en: Rub this cream on your knee, then lie down and rest.

sentences.native: ಮೂರು ದಿನದಿಂದ ಮಾತ್ರೆ ತಗೋತಿದ್ದೀನಿ, ಆದ್ರೂ ಕೆಮ್ಮು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಆಗಿಲ್ಲ.
sentences.roman: mūru dinadinda mātre tagōtiddīni, ādrū kemmu kaḍime āgilla.
sentences.en: I've been taking the tablets for three days but the cough hasn't eased.
Get well soon, I'll call you tomorrow. (informal)
